in_marathi.name: Ashlina
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashlina हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashlina is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ash’ meaning night and ‘Lina’ meaning Goddess. It is a name for the Goddess of the Night or Shakti, the divine feminine energy.
